steps.note: Open the Single Stage creation screen.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.
Switch the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product with quantity 10; do not select a delivery location.
Confirm the RFQ sheet rendered the fields relevant to the case.
Verify the delivery location remains blank.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify the automatic title has not been generated while the location is invalid.
Add one QA test vendor as required before attempting publication.
Attempt publication and assert that Procol refuses the event because the required delivery location is empty.
Assert the empty delivery location is highlighted with a required-field error.
